    • setIsValidation

      ICalibrationRequestBuilder setIsValidation(boolean isValidation)
      sets whether this calibration routine will be only to validate the existing calibration (default, false). If true, statistics on the accuracy of the validation will be shown at the end of the validate calibration routine. The existing calibration will not be affected. If the device is not currently calibrated and this value is true, the call to ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI.runCalibration(int, ICaptureStatusCallback) will fail.
      Parameters:
      isValidation - whether this calibration routine will be only to validate the existing calibration (default, false)
      Returns:
      builder

    • setNumberOfValidationSteps

      ICalibrationRequestBuilder setNumberOfValidationSteps(int numberOfValidationSteps)
      sets the number of validation steps that will be used for the validation calibration routine (default, 3). This option is only used if ICalibrationRequest.getIsValidation() is true. Minimum validation steps is 1.
      Parameters:
      numberOfValidationSteps - (default, 3)
      Returns:
      builder
